name: Recall Palm
description: Strike with a palm form recalled in every detail so each motion lands as it did when first learned.

name: Retraced Step
description: Walk back along a path taken once before without a false step by recalling each footfall.

name: Touch Trace
description: Lay a hand on an object and read the faint trace of the last hand that held it.

name: Held Form
description: Hold a guard exactly as it was drilled so the body keeps its shape under a heavy blow.

name: Face Keeping
description: Fix a face and a stance in the mind so completely that the person can be known again in any light.

name: Sharp Recall
description: Call back a trained form so sharply that the body performs it as if freshly taught to the user or an ally.

name: Memory Jab
description: Jab at a spot the foe was seen to guard poorly a moment ago and strike it before the foe changes.

name: Word Keeping
description: Hold the exact words of a speaker and the tone they were said in so a lie can be caught against them later.

name: Thought Latch
description: Latch the mind to one remembered thing so a stunning blow cannot knock the stance loose.

name: Swift Recall
description: Move along a route seen once with each turn already known and no pause to choose.

name: Blur Touch
description: Touch a foe and blur the foe's memory of the last second so the foe loses count of the strikes.

name: Quick Tally
description: Tally in a glance the number and place of every person in a room and keep it unblurred.

name: Imprinted Strike
description: Strike with a pattern pressed into the body by long drill until it needs no thought.

name: Imprint Reading
description: Read the shape left in a cushion or a floor by whoever sat or stood there last.

name: Pressed Guard
description: Take a guard that has been pressed into the arms by countless repetitions and keep it through a hard hit.

name: Patterned Pace
description: Advance on a drilled pattern of steps that the body repeats exactly even when the mind is shaken.

name: Fix Pattern
description: Help an ally press a half-learned pattern into the body by guiding the ally through it again and again.

name: Soft Blur
description: Soften the edges of a foe's recollection of the user's stance so the foe misjudges the distance.

name: Trace Fist
description: Throw a fist along the fading trace of the foe's last movement and meet the foe where it ended.

name: Trace Following
description: Follow the faint qi trace a person left on the ground to the place where the person went.

name: Lingering Guard
description: Leave a lingering after-image of a guard that takes the first blow meant for the real one.

name: Residue Reading
description: Read the residue a spent technique leaves in the air to tell what kind it was and how strong.

name: Faded Step
description: Step so lightly that the foe's mind loses the place where the user stood.

name: Vestige Palm
description: Strike with a palm that carries the vestige of a stronger blow once struck in the same place.

name: Lingering Hand
description: Rest a hand on an ally and leave a lingering memory of strength in the ally's limbs.

name: Smudge Word
description: Say a short word that smudges the foe's memory of what was about to be done.

name: Keepsake Fist
description: Hit with a fist driven by the remembered face of someone the user would not fail.

name: Keepsake Reading
description: Hold a worn keepsake and feel the warmth of the one who kept it longest.

name: Warm Remembrance
description: Bring to mind a kindness shared with an ally until the glow of it steadies the ally's nerve.

name: Fond Guard
description: Guard with the memory of someone dear held in front of the chest until the blow falls short.

name: Quiet Retrace
description: Retrace a walked path in perfect silence by recalling where the loose boards were.

name: Fade Brush
description: Brush past a foe and leave the foe unsure whether anyone was there.

name: Retained Fist
description: Throw a fist that remembers the exact spot that a former blow found weak.

name: Retained Weight
description: Recall the feel of bearing a heavy load and settle the body into the same braced posture.

name: Detail Catch
description: Catch the small detail in a scene that every other eye passes over and hold it clear.

name: Rehearsed Step
description: Take a step that has been rehearsed so often it lands on the exact stone it was meant to.

name: Rehearsed Word
description: Speak a rehearsed cue to an ally and set off the whole drilled response at once.

name: Dim Recollection
description: Dim the foe's recollection of the last exchange so the foe falls back on habit.
